## Eric Han

### Tenure

### Title

Lead Designer

### Signature

[![EricHanSig](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/ce/EricHanSig.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/150?cb=20260109135430)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/ce/EricHanSig.png/revision/latest?cb=20260109135430)

**Eric Han Cho** is a Korean-American Hot Wheels designer who has been working at Mattel since 2013. He is currently the lead designer for die-cast design, having in the past been a senior designer for Hot Wheels Track and Playsets. Much of his work focuses around the [Track Builder](/wiki/Track_Builder) and [Hot Wheels Action](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_Action) lines. [Orange Track Diecast interviewed Eric](https://orangetrackdiecast.com/2019/02/13/question-answer-with-hot-wheels-designer-eric-han/) in February 2019 and featured some of his designs which include (but not limited to): Hot Wheels Super Ultimate Garage, [Hot Wheels Display Case](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_Display_Case), [2015 Ford Mustang GT Convertible](/wiki/2015_Ford_Mustang_GT_Convertible), [Yondu](/wiki/Yondu) and [Gruppo x24](/wiki/Gruppo_x24). On the side he operates the clothing line **Elite Menace**.
